title: Honeyed Briny Canadian Lemon Pickle
description: A tangy and refreshing side dish made with unwaxed lemons, featuring a touch of sweetness from honey and a burst of brininess from shio-cure.
instructions: Rinse the lemon slices under cold running water to remove any bitterness.
In a large bowl, mix together the honey, shio-cure, and black peppercorns.
Add the lemon slices to the bowl and toss to coat with the honey-shio-cure mixture.
Place a large agave leaf on a flat surface and arrange 4 lemon slices in the center of the leaf.
Top the lemon slices with a sprinkle of chopped fresh dill.
Roll the agave leaf into a tight cylinder and secure with a small toothpick, if needed.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to make 3 more pickles.
Place the pickles in a large bowl and cover with plastic wrap.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional fresh dill, if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
